title_zh: 我国成功发射卫星互联网低轨28组卫星
title_en: China Successfully Launches 28th Group of Low-Orbit Satellite Internet Satellites
summary_zh: 10月25日10时3分，我国在海南商业航天发射场使用长征八号甲运载火箭，成功将卫星互联网低轨28组卫星送入预定轨道。
summary_en: At 10:03 on October 25, China successfully launched the 28th group of low-orbit satellite internet satellites from the Hainan Commercial Spacecraft Launch Site using a Long March 8A rocket, with the satellites entering their planned orbit.
